Yes! You can migrate search templates. In Workplace XT, search templates are stored in the workspace. In Content Navigator, the templates are stored in the application repository. You can export the search template as an XML file from Workplace XT and then import it into Content Navigator. The XML file structure is compatible between the two clients.

Here are the steps:
1. In Workplace XT, go to the search templates area
2. Export the search template - this creates an XML file
3. In IBM Content Navigator, go to the corresponding location
4. Import the XML file
